title: Registered nurse transitioning to healthcare data analyst
description: A 6-year med-surg RN pivoting into healthcare data analytics (Excel, basic SQL, Epic EHR, quality metrics) evaluated against 8 postings: a clinical quality analyst gap target, two other clinical-data roles that value domain knowledge, a marginal bedside ED nursing job, and software, sales, and finance distractors.
rationale: This scenario stresses cross-domain career-changer matching: the signal for j1-j3 is healthcare domain knowledge (Epic EHR, CMS/HEDIS quality metrics, chart abstraction) rather than a software stack, and a matcher that only counts tooling keywords will miss why this resume fits analyst roles. Gap target j1 overlaps strongly on Excel, Epic, quality metrics, chart abstraction, and clinical background (justifying grade 3) while requiring Tableau the resume lacks entirely (high) and SQL fluency the resume only partially covers via 'Basic SQL' (medium), with R or SAS and Epic Clarity certification preferred (low). j4 probes the direction of the transition: a bedside ED nursing job shares the resume's license and Epic charting history but demands emergency-specialty experience the med-surg resume lacks and sits outside the analyst family the resume is moving toward — marginal grade 1. j6 is a deliberately trap-ish distractor: healthcare vocabulary (Epic, EHR, HL7 FHIR) wrapped around a pure data-engineering stack (Spark, Airflow, dbt) — grade 0, though not tagged keyword-trap because overlap with the resume's actual skill tokens stays modest. j5, j7, and j8 are pure software, device-sales, and finance distractors, with j8's Excel/SQL mentions providing mild lexical pull.

resume.summary: Registered nurse with 6 years of acute-care experience transitioning into healthcare data analytics. Led unit-level quality reporting — chart audits, CMS core measure abstraction, and Excel dashboards for falls and infection rates — and recently completed a data analytics certificate covering SQL fundamentals. Brings deep clinical workflow knowledge and Epic documentation experience from the bedside side of the data.

experience.title: Charge Nurse, Medical-Surgical Unit
bullets: Led quality reporting for a 32-bed unit: abstracted 40+ charts monthly for CMS core measures and validated data before submission
Built an Excel dashboard with pivot tables tracking falls, CAUTI, and pressure-injury rates, adopted by three sister units
Co-led a falls-reduction initiative that cut the unit fall rate from 4.1 to 2.3 per 1,000 patient-days in 9 months
Served as Epic superuser during two upgrade rollouts, training 45 nurses on documentation changes

experience.title: Registered Nurse, Medical-Surgical Unit
bullets: Provided direct care for 5-6 acute patients per shift on a high-turnover 32-bed unit
Documented assessments and interventions in Epic with 98% chart-audit compliance
Reported and followed up on patient-safety events, contributing to two root cause analyses
Joined the hospital quality committee as the unit's data liaison for monthly metric reviews

experience.title: Registered Nurse
bullets: Delivered bedside care on a 28-bed medical unit with a 5:1 patient ratio
Collected hand-hygiene and fall-risk audit data for the unit quality committee
Precepted 4 new-graduate nurses through their first year on the floor

projects.name: readmission-insights
projects.description: Capstone project for a data analytics certificate analyzing a public hospital readmissions dataset
bullets: Wrote SQL queries (joins, GROUP BY aggregations) against a public CMS readmissions dataset to compare rates by condition and hospital ownership
Summarized findings in an Excel workbook with pivot-table drilldowns and presented them to a 20-person certificate cohort

certifications: Registered Nurse (RN), Ohio Board of Nursing

jobs.raw_text:
Clinical Quality Data Analyst — Meridian Health System (Hybrid, Columbus OH)

Meridian Health System operates six hospitals and forty clinics across central Ohio. Our Quality & Patient Safety team is hiring a Clinical Quality Data Analyst to turn EHR data into action.

What you will do:
- Query Epic Clarity data to build monthly quality and patient-safety reports
- Build and maintain Tableau dashboards tracking readmissions, falls, and infection rates
- Abstract and validate clinical records for CMS core measure submissions
- Partner with unit leaders and quality committees to interpret trends and target improvement work

Requirements: SQL (complex joins and subqueries), Tableau, Microsoft Excel, Epic EHR, CMS core measures and NHSN quality metrics. 3+ years in a clinical or healthcare quality role, 1+ years working with reporting or analytics tools in a healthcare setting. Bachelor's degree in nursing, health information management, or a related field; working knowledge of HIPAA and PHI handling; active RN license strongly preferred.

Nice to have: R or SAS, Epic Clarity data model certification, CPHQ.

Clinical Quality Data Abstractor — Lakemont Regional Medical Center (Hybrid, Columbus OH)

Lakemont Regional is a 380-bed teaching hospital. Our quality department needs a Clinical Quality Data Abstractor to keep our registry submissions accurate and on time.

You will abstract medical records for cardiac and stroke registries, validate abstracted data against registry specifications, reconcile discrepancies with clinical teams, and submit monthly NHSN infection-surveillance data.

Requirements: chart abstraction, Epic EHR, Microsoft Excel, clinical terminology, registry specifications (Get With The Guidelines, NHSN). 2+ years of clinical or health-information experience. Associate or bachelor's degree in nursing or health information management. Bonus: RN or LPN license, prior registry abstraction experience.

Population Health Data Coordinator — Carepath Partners (Remote, US)

Carepath Partners runs value-based care programs with 60 primary-care clinics. We are hiring a Population Health Data Coordinator to keep our quality-measure engine running.

You will track HEDIS quality-measure performance across clinic panels, pull and distribute gap-in-care lists for care managers, maintain Excel reports feeding monthly clinic scorecards, and coordinate chart-chase reviews with clinic staff.

Requirements: Microsoft Excel, healthcare quality measures (HEDIS), EHR chart review, data quality checks. 2+ years in healthcare operations, quality, or care management. Bonus: basic SQL, clinical licensure (RN or LPN).

Emergency Department Staff Nurse — Mercy General Hospital (Onsite, Columbus OH)

Mercy General's Level II trauma center sees 68,000 visits a year. We are hiring experienced ED nurses for night shift.

You will provide triage and direct nursing care in a 45-bed emergency department, respond to codes, traumas, and stroke alerts, document in the Epic ED module, and mentor paramedics and new graduate nurses.

Requirements: emergency department nursing, triage assessment, ACLS and PALS certification, Epic EHR documentation. 2+ years of emergency department nursing experience. Active RN license; BSN preferred. Bonus: CEN certification, TNCC.

Orbitrail builds routing and tracking software for regional freight carriers. We are hiring a Backend Software Engineer to own core services.

You will design and build REST APIs for shipment tracking and routing, model logistics data in PostgreSQL and keep query performance healthy, and own services from design through deployment on AWS.

Requirements: Python, PostgreSQL, REST API design, AWS, Docker. 4+ years building production backend services. Bonus: Kafka, Terraform.

Senior Healthcare Data Engineer — Vitalstream Analytics (Remote, US)

Vitalstream Analytics builds a clinical data platform ingesting EHR feeds from Epic and other systems for 30 hospital customers. We are hiring a Senior Healthcare Data Engineer.

You will build and operate Airflow pipelines ingesting EHR and claims data, model clinical datasets in a Snowflake warehouse with dbt, implement HL7 FHIR interfaces for hospital data feeds, and tune Spark jobs processing millions of patient records.

Requirements: Python, SQL, Apache Spark, Airflow, dbt. 5+ years in data engineering. Bonus: Snowflake, HL7 FHIR standards, Epic data model familiarity.
